import json
import urllib.parse

import requests

NATIF_API_BASE_URL = "https://api.natif.ai"
API_KEY = "<API_KEY>"  # TODO: Insert or load your API-key secret here


def process_via_natif_api(file_path, workflow, language, include):
    # Encapsulates HTTP calls to the natif.ai processing API
    headers = {"Accept": "application/json", "Authorization": "ApiKey " + API_KEY}
    params = {"include": include}
    workflow_config = {"language": language}
    url = f"{NATIF_API_BASE_URL}/processing/{workflow}?{urllib.parse.urlencode(params, doseq=True)}"

    with open(file_path, "rb") as file:
        response = requests.post(
            url,
            headers=headers,
            data={"parameters": json.dumps(workflow_config)},
            files={"file": file},
        )
        if not response.ok:
            raise Exception(response.text)

        # ADVANCED: Retry logic for exceptionally long-running workflows
        while response.status_code == 202:
            processing_id = response.json()["processing_id"]
            RESULT_URI = f"${NATIF_API_BASE_URL}/processing/results/{processing_id}?{params}"
            url = RESULT_URI.format(
                processing_id=processing_id, params=urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
            )
            response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)

        return response.json()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Submit a file
    workflow = "<API_HANDLE>" # TODO: Insert or load your API-handle here
    file_path = "<FILE_PATH>"  # TODO: Insert or load your file path here
    lang = "de"
    include = ["extractions","ocr"]
    result = process_via_natif_api(file_path, workflow, lang, include)

    # "vendor name" is chosen as an example field for this extraction and can be replaced with custom fields
    vendor_name = result.get("extractions", {}).get("vendor", {}).get("name")
    if vendor_name is not None:
        print("Vendor name:", vendor_name.get("value"))
        print("Vendor name confidence:", vendor_name.get("confidence"))
    else:
        print("Vendor name could not be extracted")

<?php
$baseURL = "https://api.natif.ai";
$workflow = "<API_HANDLE>";  # TODO: Insert or load your API-handle here
$apiKey = "<API_KEY>";   # TODO: Insert or load your API-key secret here
$filePath = "<FILE_PATH>";   # TODO: Insert or load your file path here
$lang = "de";

if (!file_exists($filePath)) {
    echo ("The file {$filePath} does not exist");
    return 1;
}

$data = array('include' => array('extractions', 'ocr'));
$params = http_build_query($data, '', '&');
$queryParams = preg_replace('/%5B(?:[0-9]|[1-9][0-9]+)%5D=/', '=', $params);

$ch = curl_init();
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, "{$baseURL}/processing/{$workflow}?{$queryParams}");
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST, "POST");
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
    "Accept: application/json",
    "Authorization: ApiKey {$apiKey}",
    "Content-Type: multipart/form-data",
]);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, [
    "file" => new CURLFile($filePath),
    "parameters" => "{\"language\": \"{$lang}\"}",
]);

$response = curl_exec($ch);
$httpcode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
curl_close($ch);

if ($httpcode == 401) {
    echo ("Invalid credentials");
    return 1;
}

$json_data = json_decode($response, true);

// "vendor name" is chosen as an example field for this extraction and can be replaced with custom fields
$vendor_name = $json_data["extractions"]["vendor"]["name"] ?? false;
if ($vendor_name) {
    echo ("Vendor name: " . $vendor_name["value"] . "\n");
    echo ("Vendor name confidence: " . $vendor_name["confidence"] . "\n");
} else {
    echo ("Vendor name could not be extracted \n");
}
